status_rule: ROLLED_BACK when EXECUTE_ROLLBACK accepted else FAILED when findings non empty else RECOVERED
service_state_rule: service.state uses lowercase declared restored rolled_back only; these are not drill status_values
parallel_conflict_detail: detail is the exact prior lowercase service.state such as restored
policy_overrides_rule: only JSON boolean and numeric types apply; string typed override values are inert

encoding.determinism: byte-identical /app/build/disaster_recovery_report.json across repeated make run on unchanged fixtures

policy_resolution: defaults then top-level drill fields then policy_overrides via slaedge.ResolveDrill

dependency_graph.blocked: RESTORE_SERVICE emits DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED when a required provider is not state restored; detail is lex smallest unmet provider
dependency_graph.cycle: post audit at max seq plus one emits DEPENDENCY_CYCLE with rotated lex smallest A>B>C>A detail; entity_id is first segment
dependency_graph.orphan: unknown from_service or to_service emits ORPHAN_EDGE

restore_gate_order.rpo_breach: snapshot lag_sec strictly greater than rpo_limit_sec
restore_gate_order.rto_breach: finished_at minus started_at strictly greater than rto_limit_sec
restore_gate_order.stale_snapshot: started_at minus captured_at strictly greater than max_snapshot_age_sec
restore_gate_order.checksum: exact byte match of declared checksum versus restore checksum
restore_gate_order.wave_capacity: effective cap is min of max_wave_capacity and START_WAVE max_concurrent when max_concurrent is positive; emit when restored count already at effective cap; detail is effective cap as four digits
restore_gate_order.wave_order: cannot restore into wave index N while any started lower index wave still has zero restored services; detail is lex smallest such wave_id
restore_gate_order.region_pair: failover_target region pair src>dst must be in allowed_failovers
restore_gate_order.quorum: required healthy probes is ceil total times health_quorum_pct over 100
restore_gate_order.rollback: EXECUTE_ROLLBACK sets target service and direct dependents only to rolled_back; grandchildren stay unchanged
restore_gate_order.risk: weighted sum of finding kinds; RISK_CEILING_HIT when score strictly greater than risk_ceiling
restore_gate_order.rpo_rto_stale_equality: lag duration or age equal to the limit must not breach

finding_id.format: drill_id double colon entity_id double colon event_seq as four decimal digits
finding_id.event_seq_source: seq field of the triggering replay event not replay index

finding_entity_detail.SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT: entity_id is snapshot_id; detail is provided checksum
finding_entity_detail.RPO_BREACH: entity_id is snapshot_id; detail is lag_sec as four digits
finding_entity_detail.RTO_BREACH: entity_id is service_id; detail is duration sec as four digits
finding_entity_detail.DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: entity_id is first cycle segment; detail is full rotated cycle
finding_entity_detail.DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED: entity_id is service_id; detail is unmet provider
finding_entity_detail.WAVE_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: entity_id is wave_id; detail is capacity as four digits
finding_entity_detail.HEALTH_QUORUM_MISS: entity_id is drill_id; detail is healthy count as four digits
finding_entity_detail.STALE_SNAPSHOT: entity_id is snapshot_id; detail is captured_at
finding_entity_detail.REGION_PAIR_DENIED: entity_id is failover_target; detail is src>dst pair
finding_entity_detail.PARALLEL_CONFLICT: entity_id is service_id; detail is prior state
finding_entity_detail.ORPHAN_EDGE: entity_id is unknown service; detail is the other service
finding_entity_detail.CRITICAL_PROBE_FAIL: entity_id is probe_id; detail is service_id
finding_entity_detail.RISK_CEILING_HIT: entity_id is drill_id; detail is risk score as four digits
finding_entity_detail.INSUFFICIENT_REPLICAS: entity_id is service_id; detail is replica_count as four digits
finding_entity_detail.WAVE_ORDER_VIOLATION: entity_id is wave_id; detail is blocking prior wave_id
finding_entity_detail.SNAPSHOT_MISSING: entity_id is snapshot_id; detail is service_id
finding_entity_detail.UNKNOWN_SERVICE: entity_id is service_id; detail is snapshot_id
finding_entity_detail.ROLLBACK_INCOMPLETE: entity_id is service_id; detail is reason
